subject: general
question: 1024 megabytes is equal to:
solution:
The correct answer is **__1 Gigabyte.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One gigabyte in the memory context of data storage comprises 1024 MB (megabyte) or 1 million bytes.
 
• In Sl units, it is written as 109. This is the most commonly used unit of storage in modern times.
 
• **1 Gigabyte = 1024 Megabytes.**
 
• 1 Terabyte = 1024 Gigabytes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unit Conversion Table:**

 
 
• 4 bit = 1 Nibble.
 
• 8 bit = 1 byte.
 
• 1 kB (kilobyte) = 1024 byte.
 
• 1 MB (megabyte) = 1024 KB.
 
• 1 GB (gigabyte) = 1024 MB.
 
• 1 TB (terabyte) = 1024 GB.
 
• 1 PB (petabyte) = 1024 TB.
 
• 1 XB (Exabyte) = 1024 PB.
 
• 1ZB (zettabyte) = 1024 XB.
 
• 1 YB (yottabyte) = 1024 ZB.
